detection_miss_evidence: Area-ratio Q1 had 21/293 FN (recall 0.9283) versus Q3 2/297 FN (recall 0.9933). Min-side Q1 had 15/295 FN (recall 0.9492) versus Q2 6/480 (0.9875).
localization_evidence: Area-ratio Q1 contained 15/16 localization failures. Min-side Q1 localization-failure rate was 3.73% versus 0.44% in Q4.
effect_magnitude: Area-ratio FN-rate gap 6.49 pp (RR 8.72); min-side gap 3.83 pp (RR 3.88).
uncertainty: Area-ratio gap 95% CI 3.28 to 10.34 pp and RR CI 3.50 to 49.99; wide upper bound because the comparison bin had only 2 FN. Non-monotonicity remains because the largest-size quartile also had 10-11 FN.
multivariable_support: The preselected min-side miss coefficient was not stable after adjustment (coefficient CI crosses 0), but smaller min-side retained localization support (OR per SD 0.23; coefficient CI -2.37 to -0.43).
interpretation: Small bbox representation is associated especially with localization failure, but size alone does not explain all misses and the pattern is not monotonic.
candidate_model_implication: Test small-object-sensitive localization or scale-preserving strategies without assuming that simple global upscaling is sufficient.

detection_miss_evidence: X-position Q4 and Y-position Q1 had the highest directional miss rates, but image-edge quartiles were non-monotonic and the high-vs-low edge-distance gap CI crossed 0.
localization_evidence: Localization rates varied by x/y and edge quartile, but no single monotonic image-edge pattern dominated.
effect_magnitude: Largest positional FN-rate gaps were 2.86 pp for x and 2.77 pp for y; image-edge selected gap was 2.30 pp.
uncertainty: X and image-edge gap CIs included 0; Y gap CI was 0.37 to 5.36 pp. Position is confounded with acquisition/layout.
multivariable_support: Image-edge distance had a positive adjusted miss coefficient (OR 1.44 per SD; coefficient CI 0.08 to 0.71), opposite to a simple near-edge-risk story; localization CI crossed 0.
interpretation: Position matters in some regions, but neither near-image-edge nor a single direction gives a stable general rule.
candidate_model_implication: Use spatially stratified diagnostics or augmentation only after confirming the non-linear/layout-specific pattern.

detection_miss_evidence: The highest-risk aspect-ratio quartile had 11/249 FN versus 7/288 in the lowest quartile; the gap CI crossed 0.
localization_evidence: Localization-failure rates were similar across several aspect-ratio quartiles and the selected gap CI crossed 0.
uncertainty: FN gap CI -1.83 to 5.67 pp; localization gap CI -0.91 to 2.98 pp.
multivariable_support: Adjusted miss and localization coefficient CIs both crossed 0.
interpretation: Bbox aspect ratio is only a shape proxy and currently provides weak, unstable evidence.
candidate_model_implication: Do not prioritize a shape-specific intervention from B0 evidence alone.

detection_miss_evidence: Robust-CNR Q1 had 15/287 FN (recall 0.9477) versus Q2 4/287 (0.9861). Absolute-contrast Q1 had 12/307 FN, but its miss gap CI crossed 0. Signed contrast was non-monotonic.
localization_evidence: CNR Q1 had 11 localization failures; absolute-contrast Q1 also had 11 versus 0 in Q4. Signed-contrast Q4 had 10 versus 0 in Q1, showing polarity/non-linearity.
effect_magnitude: CNR FN-rate gap 3.83 pp (RR 3.44); absolute-contrast localization gap 3.58 pp.
uncertainty: CNR gap CI 0.68 to 7.30 pp with RR CI 1.27 to 26.66. Absolute-contrast FN gap CI crossed 0, while localization gap CI was 1.09 to 6.64 pp.
multivariable_support: Absolute contrast was not independently stable for miss, but higher absolute contrast was associated with lower localization-failure odds (OR 0.38 per SD; coefficient CI -1.67 to -0.25).
interpretation: Low image-derived visibility is associated more consistently with localization failure than with every miss. These features are not physical density measurements.
candidate_model_implication: Test controlled photometric robustness or contrast-aware representation while monitoring background amplification and artifact control.

detection_miss_evidence: Background-gradient Q2 had 15/287 FN versus 2/287 in Q1; gradient and IQR patterns were non-monotonic rather than simply worse at the maximum quartile.
localization_evidence: Background-IQR Q2 had 7 localization failures versus 1 in Q4. Gradient localization gaps were smaller and less stable.
effect_magnitude: Gradient FN-rate gap 4.53 pp (RR 6.20); background-IQR localization gap 2.08 pp.
uncertainty: Gradient gap CI 1.50 to 7.63 pp but RR CI was wide (1.92 to 37.61). Object-IQR miss/localization gap CIs crossed 0.
multivariable_support: Background-gradient adjusted miss and localization coefficient CIs crossed 0 and the miss direction changed under adjustment.
interpretation: Some mid-range background-complexity conditions concentrate errors, but a monotonic high-complexity rule is unsupported and confounding is likely.
candidate_model_implication: Test context/background robustness only with condition-stratified evaluation; do not treat a single complexity cutoff as operational.

detection_miss_evidence: Nearest inferred-product-edge quartile had 20/287 FN (recall 0.9303) versus 4/287 in the farthest quartile (0.9861).
localization_evidence: Nearest quartile had 9 localization failures versus 1-2 in farther quartiles.
effect_magnitude: FN-rate gap 5.57 pp (RR 4.56); localization-rate gap 2.79 pp.
uncertainty: FN gap CI 2.88 to 8.52 pp and RR CI 2.22 to 14.82; localization gap CI 0.69 to 5.65 pp. Boundary itself has no segmentation GT.
multivariable_support: Greater inferred boundary distance retained lower miss odds (OR 0.38 per SD; coefficient CI -1.51 to -0.60) and lower localization-failure odds (OR 0.41; coefficient CI -1.55 to -0.51).
interpretation: This is the most consistent within-dataset association across univariate and adjusted analyses, but it remains an inferred-boundary proxy and cannot be promoted to a verified physical product-edge effect.
candidate_model_implication: Prioritize edge/context localization diagnostics; validate the boundary proxy before any product-edge-aware training or operating rule.
